Name: Tablet Deck
Author: xattribution
Description: Star Citizen controls from Tablet Deck on your Stream Deck: the same icons, colours and lit toggles as your tablets, your keybinds followed, and views pushed to your decks.

Actions.Name: Control
Actions.Tooltip: Press a Star Citizen control (holds while the key is held, for hold controls)

Actions.Name: Show view
Actions.Tooltip: Put a view (Flight, Combat, Mining…) on your tablets

Actions.Name: Away (AFK)
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle away mode: your AFK-only share links open for your crew
